name: web-gantt-timeline-with-grouped-issue-list-and-month-columns
title: Roadmap timeline: left list of grouped issues with coloured status dots and durations, and month columns with white bars
whatItIs: A pale panel with a left table (Issues, Duration) grouped under Cloud Infrastructure and Collaboration Tools with green, grey and orange dots, and a right area of month columns (Apr to Jul) with white rounded bars at positions plus small purple and red release labels at the edges.
whatItMeans: Orderly and readable; dots and bars keep a plan calm.
techniques: Place labelled bars on month columns.
Tint release tags in soft colours.

vocabulary.definition: A small label marking a version date.
